widgets_values: In a dimly lit living room, a man wearing glasses with a frantic expression clutches a round bomb tightly to his chest while leaning forward, his movements sharp and desperate. Several people in the background and to the left shrink back in fear, their bodies recoiling as tension escalates. The man gestures aggressively, his voice rising, his face contorting with emotion. The camera shifts to a close-up of his trembling hands, drenched in sweat, gripping a bomb detonator with a red button. His knuckles are white with pressure, and the metal of the detonator gleams faintly in the dim light. He mutters tensely, his lips moving rapidly. The perspective changes to a wide shot of the room, where another man charges forward from the left side of the frame, his movements urgent and purposeful, holding a gun in his outstretched hand. He raises his right hand and points the weapon at the man clutching the bomb, leaning forward as if preparing to act decisively. His expression is resolute, his mouth opening sharply as he shouts. The camera transitions to a closer shot of the man with the gun, focusing on his face as beads of sweat glisten on his forehead. His eyes dart nervously, his breathing rapid, and his lips move hesitantly as he mutters under his breath. The scene shifts back to a wide-angle view, tilted upwards, where the man with the gun fires his weapon, and the bullet cuts through the air toward the man clutching the bomb. The impact is immediate, and blood sprays outward from the man’s chest in a dramatic burst. Despite the shot, his body remains tense and unmoving, his hands gripping the detonator with an unyielding force. His bloodied face twists into an expression of madness and defiance as he screams gutturally. The camera then zooms in on the man with the gun’s face, his eyes widening in shock, pupils dilating as his expression freezes in disbelief. His lips part slightly, and his forehead glistens with sweat, his body stiff as he stammers, his mouth trembling. Finally, the camera focuses on the man clutching the bomb, zooming in slowly on his blood-smeared face. Despite his injuries, his lips curl into a faint, serene smile, his eyes reflecting a sense of inevitability. His trembling finger presses down on the red button of the detonator. His mouth moves deliberately as he speaks with calm resolve. The final shot transitions to an outdoor wide view of a city center. A deafening explosion erupts in the middle of the frame, blazing orange flames and thick black smoke billowing outward in a massive shockwave, tearing apart nearby buildings and scattering debris. The camera pulls back rapidly, capturing the devastating scale of the destruction, the gritty, grainy texture reminiscent of 1990s film enhancing the sense of chaos and catastrophe. The scene ends in silence.
